values.name: Certificate Link
values.value: For Certificate objects: the parent certificate for a certificate in a certificate chain. For Public Key objects: the corresponding certificate(s), containing the same public key.

values.name: Public Key Link
values.value: For a Private Key object: the public key corresponding to the private key. For a Certificate object: the public key contained in the certificate.

values.name: Replacement Object Link
values.value: For a Symmetric Key, an Asymmetric Private Key, or an Asymmetric Public Key object: the key that resulted from the re-key of the current key. For a Certificate object: the certificate that resulted from the re-certify. Note that there SHALL be only one such replacement object per Managed Object.

values.name: Replaced Object Link
values.value: For a Symmetric Key, an Asymmetric Private Key, or an Asymmetric Public Key object: the key that was re-keyed to obtain the current key. For a Certificate object: the certificate that was re-certified to obtain the current certificate.

values.name: Derivation Base Object Link
values.value: For a derived Symmetric Key or Secret Data object: the object(s) from which the current symmetric key was derived.

values.name: Parent Link
values.value: For all object types: the container or other parent object corresponding to the object.

values.name: Next Link
values.value: For all object types: the next object to this object.

values.name: Previous Link
values.value: For all object types: the previous object to this object.

values.name: Child Link
values.value: For all object types: the subordinate, derived or other child object corresponding to the object.

values.name: Wrapping Key Link
values.value: For wrapped objects: the object that was used to wrap this object.

values.name: Derived Key Link
values.value: The symmetric key(s) or Secret Data object(s) that were derived from the current object.
